summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT (May 2026) specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and sensing systems. Deployed TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at 18 FPS on Jetson, ZoeDepth depth estimation with ±8% 3D error, and YOLOv8 detection from 78% to 97.5% accuracy — integrating inference with hardware across ADAS, robotics, and embedded platforms using Python and C++.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Designed a custom wavelet bank for noise suppression combined with optimized image stitching, achieving PSNR of 86 vs PSNR 65 for homography baseline.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis integrating stitching, denoising, and depth estimation.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained and evaluated YOLOv8 detection models on a custom annotated dataset; improved classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; deployed in consumer mobile app.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual Transformer) on a custom dataset; built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing improvements and model tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on Jetson with VL53L0X ToF sensing for contact-aware grasping; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Built a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter → Flask-SocketIO → Jetson+Arduino) with faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) and Gemini intent classification (<500ms).
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; resolved 11 integration failures including false-positive detections and rolling-shutter depth issues.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); integrated into adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 (30 vehicles, 10 pedestrians); achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending real-time control commands to STM32 over UART with interrupt-driven multi-servo PWM.
Deployed FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
